title: Nintendo eShop digital gifting to family group members from 16 Nov on Switch and Switch 2 (system 23.5.0)

sources.note: Nintendo Japan, 10 Nov: gift feature from Tue 17 Nov JST on system 23.5.0 or later; family group; some products excluded; child accounts cannot send; limited number in a period; sent from Mohammad

Nintendo of America, 9 Nov: added to Nintendo eShop on Switch and Switch 2 on Nov. 16; games, DLC and upgrade packs; family group up to 8; supervised accounts cannot send; gifts arrive on the HOME Menu, playable right away; system 23.5.0

angle.hook: Switch players can gift digital games for the first time

angle.what_it_means_here: families in the region with Nintendo accounts can send a game straight to a family member's console
